phase_name: Integrate cross-task overlap check into cmd_acquire

objectives.description: Wire mutex + cross-task overlap scan into cmd_acquire before own-task mkdir

deviations.description: release the mutex on every return path
deviations.reason: Used a function-scoped 'trap release_scope_mutex RETURN' instead of instrumenting each individual return statement. Empirically verified in bash that this fires exactly once, on cmd_acquire's own return, regardless of which internal return executes or which nested functions run in between -- functionally equivalent to per-return release calls but requires zero edits to the pre-existing branches.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — used a RETURN trap instead of per-return-statement release calls; verified empirically)*
